shape.description: Flat printed plastic plaque of jungle ferns with orange curled tips. Two pegs along the bottom edge plug into the outer rim of a T-02 half circle.
shape.sizeBasis: Rough estimate: one cell about 52 mm and one slot about 36 mm, scaled from Joey's hand in IMG_0954 and IMG_0956; no ruler measurement.

physics.behaviour: Decoration only. No marble touches it.

evidence.shows: Level 2: plugged into the T-02 between A2 and M-61, red arrows down onto the rim
Level 3: plugged into the T-02 between A3 and A5

assumptions: faces uses E=+x, W=-x, S=+y, N=-y, in the piece's own frame. Heights are slots above the floor when the piece stands on the floor or, where stated, above the top of its supports.
openQuestions: Does it fit any curved track with rim holes, or only T-02?
